old_target_interpretation.rear_geometry_provenance: Caller-supplied shared old geometry; rear JSON has no embedded parameter hash.

old_exact_angle_assessment.interpretation: One static reference per physical joint; no per-mode recentering, clipping or angular wrapping. Offsets maximize endpoint reserve but cannot reduce required span.
old_exact_angle_assessment.basis: Original saved joint angles plus the current fixture/flat envelope

reprojected_world_target_assessment.interpretation: One static reference per physical joint; no per-mode recentering, clipping or angular wrapping. Offsets maximize endpoint reserve but cannot reduce required span.
reprojected_world_target_assessment.basis: Current-geometry IK of the unchanged old body poses and world axle targets, plus current fixture/flat angles

limitations: Only required angle envelopes are assessed. No load, mass, contact, collision, speed, thermal or stair validation.
The old dense front motion and rear pose are separate references, not a verified continuous four-leg stair sequence.
Static offsets are normalized mathematical references; encoder zeros, signs and hardware homing remain uncommissioned.
